passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: Hey Meone! Whatever is the matter? You've been following me nicely till now.
[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Wilfred: Meone! Get back here you useless cat!
[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: Uh oh... what is that thing!? Ugh... fine! Meone stay over there! I'll fight it off!
[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Wilfred: My attacks... they aren't doing anything! It's like I'm poking him with a feather!
[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 5
passages.text:
Wilfred: He's ignoring me too! How dare you! Don't just walk past me! You should be dead by now!
[[Line 6]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: Wait what is he doing? Is he lifting the rubble? Wait it's going to-
[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Wilfred: Oh. Nice of you to come back Meone. Don't you dare run off again!
[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Wilfred: (I can't let Meone die. She's all that remains of mother...)
[[Line 10]]
